primary.title: The Kanunname of Suleiman the Magnificent
primary.author: Suleiman I
primary.rationale: This is a collection of laws and decrees issued by Suleiman, representing his direct legislative authority and vision for the Ottoman Empire. It is a foundational document for understanding his reign.

primary.title: The Book of Counsel (Kitab-ı Mu'in-i Ta'at)
primary.author: Suleiman I
primary.rationale: This work is attributed to Suleiman and offers insights into his personal reflections, moral guidance, and administrative philosophy. It provides a more intimate look at his thoughts.

secondary.title: Suleiman the Magnificent: The Man, His Life, His Epoch
secondary.author: André Clot
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive biography by a respected historian, offering a detailed account of Suleiman's life, reign, and impact on the Ottoman Empire and Europe. Published by a major academic press.

secondary.title: Suleiman the Magnificent and His Age: The Ottoman Empire in the Sixteenth Century
secondary.author: Halil İnalcık
secondary.rationale: While slightly before the 1976 cutoff, İnalcık is a towering figure in Ottoman history, and this work is foundational. It's a seminal scholarly analysis of the period and Suleiman's role within it. Later editions or related articles might be available.

secondary.title: The Ottoman Empire, 1300-1650: The Structure of Power
secondary.author: Colin Imber
secondary.rationale: This book provides a detailed analysis of the Ottoman state's structure during Suleiman's era, offering crucial context for his rule and administrative achievements. It is a highly regarded academic work.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources directly authored by Suleiman are rare and often exist in manuscript form or in collections of Ottoman documents. The Kanunname and attributed works are the most accessible representations of his direct voice. Secondary sources are abundant, with many excellent scholarly works published after 1976. The inclusion of İnalcık's work is due to its immense scholarly importance, even if it slightly predates the specified year.
